abstract: A 2-month-old female baby was noticed to have liver tumor. A hemangioma of the right lobe was suspected from the findings by celiac angiography. Histologic findings of the surgically resected material revealed choriocarcinoma of the liver. At autopsy, multiple metastatic nodules were found in the lungs, but remnant liver, ovaries, uterus, mediastinum, and sacrococcygeal region were free of tumor. The ovary had several thecalutein cysts, and the endometrium of the uterus showed pseudodecidual change of the stroma. The mother died two months later. Although histologic materials were not available, the clinical findings including a high value of serum HCG seemed to show that she had been affected by choriocarcinoma. The most probable origin of the choriocarcinoma in the infant from the mother is discussed.
abstract_ja: 生後2か月の女児が肝腫瘍を指摘された。腹腔動脈造影の所見から右葉の血管腫が疑われた。手術切除された組織の組織学的所見で肝絨毛癌と判明した。剖検では肺に多発性の転移性結節が認められたが、残存肝、卵巣、子宮、縦隔、仙尾部には腫瘍はなかった。卵巣には多数の黄体化莢膜細胞嚢胞があり、子宮内膜の間質には偽脱落膜変化が見られた。母親は2か月後に死亡した。組織標本は入手できなかったが、血清hCGの高値などの臨床所見から、母親も絨毛癌に罹患していたと考えられた。乳児の絨毛癌が母親に由来する可能性について考察する。
